summary: Keep the go directive at the repo .go-version floor and do not pin an older or affected toolchain.
reason: The published module declared go 1.26.5 with toolchain go1.26.4. Both are below the repo floor and still affected by GO-2026-6809 (fixed in go1.26.10 and go1.27.3). A go directive below .go-version is blocked when go.mod is edited. A toolchain line equal to the go directive is redundant: go mod tidy deletes it and go build refuses to run until it is gone.
validated_outcome: go build ./... and go mod tidy -diff succeed on Go 1.26.10.
